means.example-sentence: It is indeed a shame that we had nothing but rain all the while we were staying here.
means.sentence-jp: 私たちがここに滞在していた間ずっと雨降りばかりだったのは, 本当に残念なことだ。

cloze.maskedText: It is indeed a shame that we had ____ rain all the while we were staying here.

notes: 『〜以外は何も...(し)ない』の文字どおりの意味もある。
